info.title: hydromart-digital drafts the AI web may make (depot-service, crm-service)
info.description:
HD-17. The closed list of writes the AI web's token may make: in depot-service a price proposal (status PENDING) and a purchase order (status DRAFT), in crm-service an in-app/push campaign (status DRAFT, nothing sent). Nothing here decides anything: HQ approves or rejects the price proposal in /hq/pricing, a staff member reviews the purchase order and presses Kirim, and a staff member with the campaign permission reviews the campaign and presses Kirim, exactly as for a draft a person made. Approval, rejection, import, send, receive and every other write answer 403 to the AI token.

Authentication: the person's own AI-web token from POST /auth/api/v1/auth/handoff/token (auth.openapi.json): ES256, aud hydromart-ai, 15 minutes. hydromart-digital applies that person's own role and depots exactly as on the staff create route: price proposals need the depotAdmin capability (a depot manager) at that depot, purchase orders the procurement capability at that depot, campaigns the depotCampaign capability at that depot; otherwise 403. A machine token or a staff session token is refused with 403.

Audit: every call is written to the audit trail BEFORE it runs, with the X-AI-Suggestion-Id (suggestionId), and is refused with 503 when it cannot be written.

Rate limit: counted per account (the token's sub), at the edge and again in the service; a 429 carries Retry-After.

Compatibility: a field may be added within version 1, so ignore a key you do not know; removing or renaming one is a new contract version.

HD-21 (CRM calon mitra): the routes under /depot/api/v1/ai/crm and /depot/api/v1/ai/drafts/depots/from-crm are the draft and the access read the AI web's CRM uses in depot-service. The draft is not an approval either: HQ activates it as a depot in hydromart-digital.

HD-21 also reads: GET /depot/api/v1/ai/crm/legacy-applications (the open franchise applications) and GET /auth/api/v1/ai/crm/pic-candidates (staff who may be a PIC).

post.summary: Draft a price proposal for HQ to decide.
post.description: Makes a PENDING per-product price proposal for one depot, marked source AI with the reason. It joins the HQ queue (/hq/pricing) like a manager's proposal, with an "Usulan AI" badge and the reason; the people who decide are told as for any proposal.

parameters.name: X-AI-Suggestion-Id
parameters.description: The AI web's id for this suggestion (a UUID). The idempotency key: the same id with the same body answers the draft it already made (200); the same id with a different body is a 409. The id is stored on the draft and written to the audit trail.

parameters.name: X-Workflow
parameters.description: Optional label for the audit trail (the workflow that made the call).

200.description: This X-AI-Suggestion-Id already made exactly this draft; it is returned unchanged.

400.description: BAD_REQUEST: X-AI-Suggestion-Id missing or not a UUID, or the body failed validation (message lists what).

401.description: UNAUTHORIZED: no token, an expired one, or one hydromart-digital cannot verify. That includes every token after AI access was switched off (the published key set is empty).

403.description: FORBIDDEN: a machine token or a staff session token, or a person whose role lacks the capability the staff route asks for, or who may not act at that depot. The same answer the staff route gives that person.

404.description: NOT_FOUND: the depot (or the supplier of that depot) does not exist.

409.description: AI_SUGGESTION_REUSED: this X-AI-Suggestion-Id already made a different draft.

429.description: RATE_LIMITED: too many calls from this account. Wait the seconds in Retry-After, then retry.

503.description: SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: the audit trail could not record the call, so nothing was drafted. Retry later.

post.summary: Draft an in-app/push campaign for staff to review and send.
post.description: Makes a campaign in status DRAFT for one depot's own customers, marked source AI with the reason. NOTHING IS SENT: it appears in the campaign list and report with an "Usulan AI" badge and the reason, and a staff member with the campaign permission reviews it and presses Kirim (that is the approval), as for any draft. The audience is resolved from the segment by the same rules as a staff depot campaign, so customers who switched promotional messages off are not in it, and opt-out is checked again for every recipient when the campaign is sent. The answer carries the audience SIZE only (totalRecipients), never a name or phone number. There is no route for the AI token to send, cancel, edit or read a campaign.

post.summary: Draft a depot from a calon mitra (HD-21).
post.description:
Records what HQ will activate as a depot, one draft per prospectId. Needs the prospectCrm capability (built in: MARKETING, SUPER_ADMIN; a custom role such as Sales when the owner grants it in the Akses screen). hydromart-digital RE-CHECKS the owner decision D1 whatever the CRM already checked: all four checklist items VERIFIED, agreementSignedOn at least 14 calendar days after prospectusHandedOn, agreementSignedOn not after today (WIB), prospectusHandedOn not after agreementSignedOn. All dates are WIB calendar days (YYYY-MM-DD). Nothing is sent to the owner and no depot is created here: HQ activates the draft in a later step.

One row per prospectId: no draft yet makes one (201); the same body again, while it is still DRAFT, answers it unchanged (200); a different body while DRAFT is a 409 DRAFT_CONFLICT; a REJECTED draft is reopened as DRAFT with the new content (201); an ACTIVATED one is a 409 ALREADY_ONBOARDED carrying depotId and depotCode.

UUIDs are compared and stored in lower case, so an upper-case prospectId is the same prospect. A reopened draft keeps `createdAt` as the FIRST creation and takes the new caller as its author.

parameters.name: X-AI-Suggestion-Id
parameters.description: The CRM sends the prospect id as its value (a UUID), and it MUST equal body.prospectId (compared case-insensitively): a different value is a 400. Written to the audit trail with the call, which keeps every suggestion id. The idempotency key of this route is the prospectId in the body.

parameters.name: X-Workflow
parameters.description: Optional label for the audit trail (the workflow that made the call).

201.description: The draft was made, or a REJECTED one was reopened (createdAt stays the first creation).

200.description: The same prospect with exactly this body already has a DRAFT; it is returned unchanged.

400.description: BAD_REQUEST: X-AI-Suggestion-Id missing, not a UUID, or not equal to body.prospectId; the body failed validation; or INVALID_DRAFT_DATES: agreementSignedOn is after today (WIB), or prospectusHandedOn is after agreementSignedOn.

401.description: UNAUTHORIZED: no token, an expired one, or one hydromart-digital cannot verify.

403.description: FORBIDDEN: a machine token, a staff session token, or a person whose role lacks prospectCrm.

409.description: DRAFT_CONFLICT: a pending draft of this prospect has different content; or ALREADY_ONBOARDED: the prospect is already a depot (the body carries depotId and depotCode).

422.description: CHECKLIST_INCOMPLETE: the body carries items, the checklist keys that are not VERIFIED; or COOLING_OFF_NOT_MET: the body carries earliestOn (YYYY-MM-DD), the first day the agreement may be signed.

429.description: RATE_LIMITED: too many calls from this account. Wait the seconds in Retry-After, then retry.

503.description: DRAFT_BUSY: two callers kept reopening the same rejected draft; nothing is wrong with the request, retry.

get.summary: What the signed-in person may do in the CRM calon mitra (HD-21).
get.description: Needs prospectRead (built in: MARKETING, DIREKTUR, HEAD_OFFICE, SUPER_ADMIN, plus any custom role the owner grants it). full and settings are evaluated against the matrix in force now, custom-role overrides included, not the compiled defaults. legalEntities are the active legal entities the person may act for under the role x legal-entity matrix of the AI read API (no grant = none; SUPER_ADMIN = every active entity).

get.summary: The open franchise applications, for the CRM's one-time import (HD-21).
get.description: Needs prospectSettings. Only the open stages (PENDING, DOC_VERIFICATION, SURVEY), never APPROVED or REJECTED, oldest first. Exactly the fields below: no GPS pin, no checklist, no projected revenue. Read only: there is no AI-token route that changes or deletes an application; the hydromart copies are removed later by a reviewed one-shot after a dry run and a separate owner confirmation. The AI web maps investmentAmountIdr to a capital RANGE at import and never stores the amount.

aiToken.description: Authorization: Bearer <accessToken> from POST /auth/api/v1/auth/handoff/token. ES256, aud hydromart-ai; carries the person's own role and depot.

currentPrice.description: The depot's current price for the product (IDR).

adjustType.description: PERCENT = signed percent; FIXED = signed rupiah delta; ABSOLUTE = the new price.

reason.description: Why the AI proposes this, in one or two sentences; shown to the person who decides. Trimmed.

status.description: PENDING on a new AI draft.

proposedBy.description: The person behind the AI token.

itemType.description: PRODUK needs productId; the others forbid it.

reason.description: Why the AI proposes this, in one or two sentences; shown to the person who decides. Trimmed.

status.description: DRAFT on a new AI draft.

code.description: BAD_REQUEST, UNAUTHORIZED, FORBIDDEN, NOT_FOUND, AI_SUGGESTION_REUSED, DRAFT_CONFLICT, DRAFT_BUSY, ALREADY_ONBOARDED, CHECKLIST_INCOMPLETE, COOLING_OFF_NOT_MET, INVALID_DRAFT_DATES, DEPOT_DRAFT_NOT_FOUND, CAMPAIGN_NO_RECIPIENTS, CAMPAIGN_SCHEDULED_IN_PAST, CAMPAIGN_SEGMENT_UNAVAILABLE, RATE_LIMITED or SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE.

message.description: For people reading logs. Route on statusCode and code.

items.description: CHECKLIST_INCOMPLETE only: the checklist keys that are not VERIFIED.

depotId.description: The depot whose customers are targeted.

messageTemplate.description: The message body. Supports {{name}} and {{phone}} tokens.

segment.description: Narrows the depot's customers. Omit for all of the depot's customers who can be messaged. There is no explicit recipient list. A value for the removed tier filter is a 400.

recencyDays.description: Last order within this many days.

lapsedDays.description: Last order older than this many days.

newWithinDays.description: First order within this many days.

scheduledFor.description: When to send once a person presses Kirim. Must not be in the past. The draft is never sent before that.

reason.description: Why the AI proposes this, in one or two sentences; shown to the person who sends it. Trimmed. It must not contain customer personal data: a run of 8 or more digits (spaces and dashes allowed between them), such as a phone number, is a 400.

channel.description: IN_APP: an inbox row plus best-effort push.

totalRecipients.description: The audience size. Never the audience itself.

createdAt.description: The FIRST creation of the draft; a reopen does not change it.

full.description: Holds prospectCrm: names, phones, every write, and calling from-crm.

settings.description: Holds prospectSettings: Hot/Warm thresholds and the legacy-application import.

applicantPhoneE164.description: Null when the number the applicant typed cannot be read as an Indonesian number.
